collection.title: Volvo S90 2016 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Volvo S90 2016 Onwards will fit, this model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
